purpose: Single targeted A/B for Order 125 hypothesis 1: expose reusable current-media inspection, audio extraction, and active-presentation audio insertion as direct generic Multi-Apps actions.
change_scope: Add three parameterized Multi-Apps facades: media.inspect_current resolves the current VLC basename through bounded filesystem.find; media.extract_audio forwards model-selected local input/output paths unchanged; presentation.insert_audio targets the active presentation URL, inserts model-selected audio on a model-selected slide, saves the same file, and verifies the media shape. Rank this reusable audio-transfer cohort for matching cross-application intent and suppress equivalent nested routes. Select PCM for model-requested WAV output and retain MP3 behavior for MP3 output. No task identity, dataset order, fixed source/output/presentation filename, expected audio, golden material, evaluator state, argument injection, or task workflow is embedded.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and strictly audit this single targeted A/B. Do not rerun it unchanged. Classify whether the remaining failure is tool selection, model arguments, media extraction, presentation insertion/save, completion, or environment. Try another materially different generic hypothesis only when the trace supports it and the per-task budget remains; otherwise mark Order 125 task_blocked and immediately continue.

implementation_evidence.failure_evidence: The untouched v131 baseline returned evaluator 0.0 after 30 steps. Initial Top-K omitted all relevant media actions. After a malformed command.run, Qwen searched for VLC audio extraction on every remaining step. Search repeatedly returned the relevant VLC media.extract_audio contract only through nested adapter.call, but the model never selected it and executed no successful mutation.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_tests: Parameterized tests use unrelated Aurora, Forest Survey, Winter Survey, and Seasonal Review media, audio, and presentation paths. They verify bounded current-media resolution, unchanged model path forwarding, active-presentation URL reuse, same-file save, media-shape read-back, direct Top-K/search routing, compact contexts, and WAV PCM selection without task data.
implementation_evidence.static_verification: Ruff check and format, compileall, project layout/deployment leakage, frozen-v1 SHA256SUMS, frozen OSWorld commit, and evaluator-tree checks passed.

selection.method: single targeted A/B for the preserved Order 125 v131 tool-discovery failure
